name: d8a_relabel
purpose: TASKS 49, step 3 of the user's order of 1 Nov: D_8a1c3dddb7 (C34H20, 54 atoms, 550 functions), killed at 115 GB in its Hessian's first phase on l5_large (32 threads, max_memory 100,000 MB), labelled again alone in its own cgroup at l5_small's per-process settings (8 threads, max_memory 24,000 MB, cap 26,624 MB, under which coronene peaked at 26 GB), with probes/mem_watch_wsl.sh sampling its memory every minute (probes/run_with_mem_watch.sh) so that a second explosion shows its phase; starts when tasks74_labels ends, beside hbc_wb97x's 24 threads

estimate.basis: l5_small's D molecules of 42-48 atoms took 13-32 h at 8 threads with four lanes sharing the server (29-31 Oct); n^3 to 54 atoms from the slowest, about 46 h, less with the server shared by two jobs instead of four lanes
